findings.finding: External input fingerprint omits .mjs used by actual generated-client runtime acceptance. Add extension and content-change regression so cached child-test acceptance cannot survive changed module runtime fixtures.

teamworkflow imports entire idempotenthttp package only for its actor/guard. Extract the existing loopback identity fixture into private shared authfixture and reuse it from both fixtures, retaining public aliases as needed.

Generic slice specialization only matches an unnamed *types.Slice. A named generic Items[T] []T is emitted as an array for Items[byte], disagreeing with Go native base64 encoding and a concretely generated schema. Inspect underlying slice and preserve its named Go type. Extend generated consumer roundtrip and generic/concrete manifest agreement regression.

TypeScript JSON parse/write Nodes accounting omits object keys, while the shared Go parser explicitly counts names. Count names in both directions and test exact boundary acceptance/rejection for ordinary objects and union payloads.
PATCH handler manually duplicates the generated draft presence state in a changed boolean. Use ProjectDraft.IsEmpty as the existing single source.

notes.conclusion: Reviewed claim uniqueness and fresh Read Committed lookup, framed namespace/scope/key digests, caller admission lock/quota, typed canonical input and exact-output restoration before commit, rollback/panic containment, committed versus unknown outcomes with primary-only reconciliation, bounded work lifetime, explicit expiry pruning and replay header whitelist. Existing acknowledgment, race, corruption and process tests exercise the important boundaries. No new defect confirmed in this area.

notes.area: T04 typed binding and query scopes
notes.conclusion: Reviewed typed selectors and owner-constrained fields; parent-derived direct relation predicates; unique lookup limited to two rows without pagination; no global fallback; authorization after binding on every replay; cancellation and callback containment. Scope matching remains separate from business authorization and starts no implicit transaction. No new defect confirmed.

Reviewed named/default map ownership, explicit complete scope selection and connection ceiling, primary/read schema alignment, persistence target single source, migration deduplication and explicit ownership, no constructors running migrations, retained schemas, per-checkout schema/UTC reset and rejection of temporary-schema shadowing. Scope objects can only originate from Isolate and retain their configured database. No new defect confirmed.

Read all changed contract JSON/schema runtime files. Reviewed concrete source identity and model exclusion, argument inclusion/root rewriting, byte-slice rules, normalized shared graph collision checks, finite wrapper chains, discriminator collision/tag enforcement, owned union payload snapshots and native restoration, bounded parse/shape work and value-free errors. Exporter/generator review followed and confirmed A03/A04 as recorded below.

notes.area: T03 lifecycle/forms and T06 middleware integration
notes.conclusion: Read all changed HTTP files and validation owners. Checked source-separated query/form parsing, shared cardinality, media/body limits, multipart cleanup, prohibition checks before normalization, typed actor/resource order, callback panic/Goexit containment, cancellation precedence, browser response mutation gating, declared errors and retry headers. Middleware marker survives framework composition and custom wrappers require explicit attestation; builtins preserve unsafe-operation bodies/statuses and only compression transforms transport. No new defect confirmed.

Generation includes internal idempotency store before consumers; test batches bound linked binaries; shared external fingerprint gates native child acceptance. Confirmed .mjs omission in fingerprint owner is A01, not a test coverage reduction.

Read every changed discovery/emission/loading/type-identity owner. Reviewed staged handwritten declarations and full overlay checking, generic constraints/typed arguments, canonical instantiation and source identities, graph bounds, named/custom codec precedence, union stubs and closed generated accessors, forms sharing URL scalar discovery and validation selectors. Confirmed named generic slice specialization defect A03; other reviewed paths have existing compiler/runtime/recovery coverage.

Read changed manifest/exporter owners and embedded HTTP/wire runtimes (the inventory labels .ts as consumer, but these are framework implementation). Reviewed v4 policy validation, one graph and owned metadata, typed status/error references, forms source grammar, discriminators/closed payloads, exact-number clients, branded required keys, exact-status/retry handling and no automatic retry. Confirmed parser/writer node-accounting mismatch A04.

Read all nine handwritten workflow implementation files. Default/named pool ownership, scoped resource policy, explicit PATCH draft mapping, generic union envelopes, typed page projection, shared name rules, transaction-bound outbox and receiving receipt/effect transaction are coherent. Confirmed duplicated draft emptiness bookkeeping A05; no new framework persistence subsystem was added.

notes.area: Integrated acceptance and final consumer source
notes.conclusion: Reviewed complete workflow tests and runtime/strict client sources: owned actual HTTP kernels and private subprocess, retained default/named schemas, PATCH persisted states, wrong parent/current authorization, concurrent two-app duplicate claim, transaction rollback, duplicate receiving effect and lifecycle cleanup. The existing T06 process-crash tests own crash-before/after-commit proof; T07 adds complete workflow process replay. Reviewed remaining client contract composition, requestflow forms and union fixture source. Generated output is covered by generator-owner review and deterministic generation; no claim of manual line-by-line generated output review.

Grouped fixes passed race/generated client acceptance. Verified private packaged public consumers with no replacements and local-only proxy; repeated native HTTP/editor measurements and independent build/generation profiles. Eight bounded fuzz targets and the final native full gate passed. No source changes after that gate; subsequent evidence/status documentation is checked separately.

boundaries: Existing dependency module cache; candidate modules verified by private archive hashes and go mod verify, with no module replacements and no network fallback.
Build/generation cold/unchanged/edited states have one sample each; runtime and editor operations have three samples. Different program shapes are not an overhead ratio.
Benchmark process-wide allocations include asynchronous publisher/receiver work; measurements ran sequentially without another compile/test workload.
Fuzz checks are bounded samples, not exhaustive proofs.
Private PostgreSQL schemas/data retained; no database reset, global cache cleanup, dependency installation, release publication or git commit/push/merge.
Existing T06 actual process-termination tests own pre/post-commit crash proof; T07 adds complete-workflow fresh-process replay.
No new vulnerability scan; earlier scanner evidence is historical. No dependency versions were changed in T07.
